title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.2.1)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.2.1 (unreleased)

Changed

  • Similarity Map: the component map is now called "Similarity Map" in the navigation, on the page and in the admin logs, so it is not mistaken for a location map. Its address is /components/similarity-map; the old /components/map is not redirected.
  • Grasshopper sign-ins last 6 hours (decision 8.166) instead of 30 minutes, so longer sessions no longer need the Refresh input; the web keeps 30 minutes.

Server notes

  • CSC_GH_TOKEN_HOURS (optional, 1 to 24, default 6) sets the lifetime of Grasshopper sign-ins; no change is needed for the default.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md
